evidence.decision: Separates recognition purpose, bounded sampling and consent to library modification.
evidence.transformation: Silent endless listening and automatic additions become explicit recognition, stopped sampling and opt-in saving.
evidence.verification: Fails prepermission recording, purposeless continued capture and library mutation without opt-in.
evidence.applicability: Verifies API availability and separates actual microphone/catalog/iCloud behavior from static flows.
evidence.handoffs: Privacy handles recording explanation; Accessibility only for recognition-driven alternatives.
evidence.distinctiveness: Shazam versus custom catalog and recognition-as-distinct-from-saving change the action sequence.
